name: jg-packages
description: Jesus Graterol's personal npm packages, built, tested, and released from one pnpm and Turborepo monorepo.
author: Jesus Graterol

scripts.check: node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts essential run lint typecheck build && pnpm test && pnpm format:check
scripts.check:full: node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts full run lint typecheck build test:e2e && node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts full run test:coverage --concurrency=4 --filter=!jg-react --filter=!jg-react-router --filter=!jg-tanstack-query --filter=!jg-react-ui && node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts full run test:coverage --concurrency=1 --filter=jg-react --filter=jg-react-router --filter=jg-tanstack-query --filter=jg-react-ui && node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts full run test:browser && pnpm format:check && pnpm release:verify
scripts.test: node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts essential run test:unit test:integration && node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts essential run test:browser --filter=!jg-utilities && node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts essential run test:e2e --concurrency=1 --filter=!@jg-packages/website
scripts.test:full: node internal/vitest-config/src/run-test-suite.ts full run test:unit test:integration test:browser test:e2e
